Waste Collection Calendar

The City's waste collection calendar is distributed annually to Barrie residents. It contains information about waste collection, waste diversion, and environmental initiatives that support a circular economy. The 2025 waste collection calendar includes details on automated cart collection starting September 8, 2025.

 

Be sure to place materials curbside by 7am on your collection day. Collectors complete routes between 7am and 6pm. If items are not curbside by 7am, there is no guarantee they will be collected.

 

Residential recycling is not managed by the City. An organization called Circular Materials is responsible for collecting residential recycling in Barrie. Circular Materials may make changes to the way recycling is collected in the future.
